thread:
drew: quick note  proposing a tiny prewarm "lease" over the gateway: client marks intent, gateway returns short lease id while warming upstream conn/kv, client references lease on real request. reduces cold p99 for short reads.
hana: +1 but must be safe-by-default. prewarm should only run for GET/HEAD unless route explicitly allows.
li: agree. recommend lease TTL ~400ms, lease header `x-rw-lease-id`, and `x-rw-prefetch: 1` for intent. gateway should sign lease to prevent forgery.
tara: hedging: bind warmed state to a single lease winner; other hedged attempts get `prefetch-status: ignored`. prewarm is a hint: on miss we fall back to normal path. also add tenant token-bucket to prevent abuse.
ops-bot: canary probe: prewarm-v1 -> 10% on /fast: cold p95 down ~100ms, upstream conns +9%, prewarm_rejects 1.5%.
drew: action items: I'll write a short RFC with header list + example for streaming trailers. Hana/Tara to draft safety and quota rules. target RFC by EOW.
